publicationText:
Joule Work: distinguish the announcement from your organization's access.

Myth: a product announcement means everyone already has access. Fact: SAP describes Joule Work's customer rollout beginning, with selected customers already using it. This does not establish your organization's entitlement.

An editorial source review checked October 15, 2026. SAP describes natural-language work across SAP and third-party data, business context from Knowledge Graph, and managed activation through SAP for Me. The guide's portfolio-wide October availability statement does not establish individual access.

No customer environment was tested for this short. Confirm your organization's availability and activation requirements before planning adoption, and recheck the dated official sources.

Official guide: https://www.sap.com/topics/events/connect/innovation-news-guide-2026
Press release: https://news.sap.com/2026/10/sap-connect-sap-puts-autonomous-enterprise-to-work/
